label: Faceted browse
description: Three pane faceted browse over a large item set: app sidebar, a fixed-width filter rail of collapsible facet groups, and a result list of composed cards. The defining trait is scale: a live total, per-facet counts, and results that carry their own metadata rather than fitting table columns. Derived from the Studio Catalog page.
when: Use when the user browses or narrows a large collection by several independent facets at once. Do NOT use table-list: a table cannot hold a filter rail, per-facet counts, or a result unit richer than a row. Do NOT use search-filtered-table, which is explicitly the single-search-no-facets case.

slots.rail: Filter rail: a range facet, a counted checkbox facet list, a toggle facet, and type-to-search selects
slots.results-header: Live result total plus a save-this-view action
slots.bulk-bar: Select-all plus batch actions, with the sort control opposite
slots.results: Result cards: type and sharing tags, title, source metadata, summary, domain, pending-suggestion chip, and a right meta column with completion and last-updated

renderNotes: Children of a VERTICAL frame must omit `sizing`. `sizing.horizontal:"FILL"` emits `flex:1`, which in a column container stretches them vertically and distributes the height evenly.
fmSlider and fmProgressBar read the VARIANT (Progress= / Completion=), not props, and collapse to zero width inside a centred row unless hosted in a fixed-width frame.
fmCheckbox and fmToggle render no text; pair them with a sibling TEXT node.
Use DIVIDER for full-width rules. RECT takes a fixed pixel width and will not span.

The six facet rows carry item-type-tag Type values resolved straight off the registry axis, one per Studio item type: facet1=Data product, facet2=Dataset, facet3=Visualization, facet4=Data process, facet5=Use case, facet6=Category. That axis mapping is a structural fact of the page (the six Studio item types are always these six facets, in this order), so Type= is authored as a real value, not a placeholder. The chip's short initials (item-type-tag's Label prop) are NOT: review round 2 found captures/faceted-browse.png actually reads DP, Da, Vi, DP, UC, Ap, including two differently-coloured "Data Products" rows sharing the same two-letter initial, which makes the initials per-tenant data, not a registry fact this recipe can author once and reuse. Carried as placeholders {{facet1_initials}} through {{facet6_initials}} accordingly, one per facet row, matching the {{facetN_label}}/{{facetN_count}} placeholders already beside them. item-type-tag's own case (ds-html-map.js) falls back to the raw Type text when Label is empty, so an unsubstituted placeholder never regresses to a blank chip; a real render substitutes the tenant's own initials at render time.

item-type-tag reads props["Show counter"] || props["Show Counter"] (registry kept both spellings across the glossary/catalog fold-in); either one true shows the counter badge, and both default false, so the registry default is off, not on.
checkbox, toggle and dropdown-select-default render no label element at all when Label is the empty string (Task 1.2), which is how a facet row's own TEXT sibling stays the only visible label.
The results-header/bulk-bar leaves (button, checkbox) are authored in ../sections/control-bar.json, spliced in here as the SECTION node above; its own renderNotes carry their deviations.

search-result-card has no completion or sharing prop (Body, Catalog, Description, Featured property 1/2, Glossary initials/label, Stage, Tech name, Title, Type only). The completion meter is a sibling progress-bar-small (own Percent text, no separate TEXT, per the doubled-percent rule above); the Shared indicator is a sibling read-only-tag Type=Shared. read-only-tag's Type=Shared paints #cbe3ff (ds-base.css .ds-tag--shared), a light blue, not a literally dark fill; it is the leaf whose Type axis names Shared, and the closest built equivalent to the capture's dark filled fmTag.

search-result-card's own Type text renders inside a single always-colored eyebrow pill (.ds-search-result-card__type, background var(--zen-color-error-50)); the fill does not change with the Type value, only the text does.

All six results render a Shared tag; the recipe does not model a non-shared result, matching every sample row in the capture. The marker is a sibling read-only-tag placed BEFORE the search-result-card instance, not inside it: the leaf has no shared prop and no slot for one, so it sits to the left of the whole card rather than in the title row the way the product's own Shared indicator does. A leaf-level shared marker (a real prop or slot on search-result-card) is a follow-up, not done here.

derivedFrom.screenshot is a 2026-03-30 product capture of Studio > Catalog on the dev tenant (1583x1100), not the 2026-08-18 capture derivedFrom.capturedOn names: the original 08-18 screenshot was not retained on disk, and this is the closest real capture of the same surface, not the Figma frame (the design, not the product).
No DS-tier slider exists (checked ds-components-authoring.md's vocabulary table): the range facet keeps fmSlider, unreplaced, same as the pre-2.2 capture.

Review round 1 (Critical): search-result-card's Stage pill and glossary badge painted unconditional fallback text ("Stage", "VH", "Vehicle") even when the props were omitted, the same defect Task 1.2 fixed for Label elsewhere. Fixed in ds-html-map.js: no Stage prop draws no stage pill at all; no Glossary initials AND no Glossary label draws no glossary badge at all. This recipe's six cards set Stage, Glossary initials and Glossary label to "" because the captured product page names neither a lifecycle stage nor a glossary relationship for these six sample rows; a future capture that has real values for either should set them instead of leaving them empty.
